name: Medal of Rescue: Bronze
descriptionTemplate:
At turn start, gain [Arg1] {Glow of Humanity}.
{To escape the snow mountain, you adopted a strategy prioritizing efficiency, watching people perish one by one. The survivors' eyes held more fear than gratitude.}
lore: To leave the snow mountain, you adopted a strategy prioritizing efficiency, watching as people fell one by one. The survivors regarded you with more fear than gratitude.
